notes.title: March content update
notes.content:
As promised the march content update is right on time.

Changes
 - 18 new scenes for the 2nd playthrough
 - 2 new characters in 2nd playthrough
 - Upgraded several older scene backgrounds
 - Upgraded several old character models
 - Minor text and background fixes

What’s next?
There will be one more larger content update with additional scenes and upgrades on the sound and music for some scenes. With that the game will leave Early Access.
The planned final release date is mid of June which will be in sync with a local gaming event to maximise promotion potential. 

In the meantime work on storyline for part 2 has already started.

notes.title: Update on 2nd Content Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44427939/805544f974f5324e4cc380e7ba86d3015f1c1f67.jpg[/img]

After having a couple of busy weekends due to some local conventions and RL work the progress with the planned 2nd content update is in line with the overall plan.
As of now, I expect it to hit Steam around mid of March. Aiming for Friday the 15th but that’s not 100% set in stone ;)

What will be new?

[list]
[*] approx 18-20 new scenes for the 2nd play through
[*] 2 upgraded character models. Admiral Horn got an upgrade, forcing me to re-render my favourite ball   video… again… I hope for the last time ever… 
[*] 1 new character appearance and a brief look at the empires forces
[*]several older scenes got some visual upgrades to get them more in line with later scenes and add some more realism
[/list]

notes.title: 1st major content update - January 2024
notes.content:
[b]content changes[/b]
- 17 new/extended scenes for the  extended playthrough mode (aka Spoilermode)
- 1 new character for the  extended playthrough mode (aka Spoilermode)
- overhaul of character models for Malcolm Tolwyn, Omega 1, Omega 7, Sigma 1, all A & C series protector battle gear

[b]techical changes[/b]
- unlocked screen resolution to all common 16:9 and 16:10 formats (please consider that the game is designed and intended for 1920x1080)
- adjusted UI to better suit the new resolutions
- changed video codec to support the Steam Deck

[b]misc[/b]
- small bug fixes and typos

[b]outlook[/b]
The target window for the next content update will be the 2nd half of March 2024, featuring approx 20 new scenes and some smaller upgrades.

notes.title: Update on the upcoming January version
notes.content:
As we approach January it’s time for some more info on the upcoming update.

Things didn’t work as initially planned as during the dive into Unreal Engine I realised that I have to fix a couple of other things first. Specifically the Frankenstein solution for the A & C Protector-Squad models which actually are not just one model but two separate ones posed in a way to hide the fact that the body is still a Gen8 model while the head is Gen9.

While past experiments to upgrade the body suit with all its morphs to Gen9 failed, I finally found a new outfit combination to keep the distinct look mostly the same but add more details. 
So, once again and hopefully for the last time, I need to go back and rerender approx 300 backgrounds and 20+ videos and short clips for the new release. And as I’m already doing that, I took the opportunity to exchange some other characters to Gen9 as well.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44427939/193c9c9607f6b86de7d81d617c22f19d4cb8d7d6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44427939/f3dabbe0bd27e3dd5948f4a98efb45ed74a9729d.png[/img][/url]

So… what else will change
There are currently 17 new or extended scenes for the spoiler mode version. Those will be sprinkled out through several chapters including some extras after the end.
They will also feature a new character that will be important for future titles.

On the technical side there will be more flexibility on screen resolutions.
I unlocked all 16:9 and 16:10 resolutions and did some UI tweaking to facilitate the changes.
But please keep in mind, the game/backgrounds have been created with 16:9 in mind

The release date will be mid January. Depending on final edits and finishing rerenders.

notes.title: Plans for the next major update
notes.content:
Well it's already been one week since launch and all's working fine, beside a constant stream of emails and requests.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44427939/713780bf61f8942e0390e35e75288fd10daf6ca3.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44427939/f693c0dbb7cb1c5cd0697d0872d0bca9b1883e65.jpg[/img][/url]

I'm already back working on the first larger update.
the currently planned content will be 
  1-2 new scenes for the main story
 15-20 new scenes for the spoiler storyline (after you finished the main at least once)
  1 new character
  some smaller bug fixes (mostly typos)

I expect to be able to publish it early to mid January...  (depending on my editor and testers availablity)

notes.title: We are live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44427939/a73ad3630b78fdbdd62e54e65b1a76760ed497f6.jpg[/img]

Finally the day has come and we are live on Steam!

So, what's different in comparison with the free build out there?

already in the current build
- 14 characters got the upgrade treatment to the latest base model generation, new outfits and all what's necessary
- 1 new Steam exclusive character with a small extra storyline
- an additional way to influence the ending (just in case you screwed up early in the game)

planed for the near future 
- 2nd gameplay mode with many additional events that happened outside of perception of our main character, to learn what others were doing and planning. There is already a brief preview in the game. After finishing the game and starting a new game you can choose to play again in the normal way of things or the "spoiler" version. Right now there are 3 minor events before our hero even arrives, to give a glimpse of things to come

Now it's time to celebra...
...
well... seems there's no time for that 
back to work on the new scenes to add more content ːsteamhappyː
